tests.description: EEPROM, U-Boot, working device tree, and Linux report the assigned identity.
Installed FPGA, boot, overlay, and runtime artifacts match the release manifest.
The board completes three independent cold boots with persistent identity.
The production application can identify and access the programmed FPGA design.
Timing locks with the assigned endpoint and remains stable for the recipe interval.
The isolated QA network observes the assigned MAC, IP, and hostname.
Configured front-end and data links pass the released functional test.
Temperatures, current, timing, and links remain within released limits during soak.
